reviews.text: A professional dog school in the heart of Budapest, with highly knowledgeable and experienced instructors. I wholeheartedly recommend the entire team to anyone who wants the best for their dog and to those who would like to delve deeper into this world and expand their knowledge in this direction.
Organized groups, knowledgeable dog trainer, understandable advice. I should have started going here much earlier (the dog, a goldie, is two and a half years old).
I can only recommend them 😊 We have taken several courses with them and, in addition to learning a lot from them, we also had a great time during the classes 😊 …

We joined you almost two years ago with our reactive dog, who has completely changed since the beginning - we have been lucky enough to work with several trainers, without exception everyone teaches with a high level of competence and takes personal needs into account, we can feel free to ask questions during and after class. We always enjoy learning with you! This year with two dogs :)
